_comment: End-of-run badges. Display text lives here; each id's condition is evaluated in scripts/systems/achievements.gd against the final GameState. Kept gentle and encouraging, in keeping with the game's tone.

achievements.title: Integration
achievements.desc: Reached the integration path — the parts of the self, working as one.

achievements.title: Held Together
achievements.desc: Made it through the run without any alter reaching a breaking point.

achievements.title: The Whole Picture
achievements.desc: Recovered the core memories and pieced the past together.

achievements.title: Aware
achievements.desc: Surfaced every piece of real DID information along the way.

achievements.title: Mediator
achievements.desc: Mended a strained bond between alters through dialogue.
